sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.6.18 "FDCAN TT trigger select register (FDCAN_TTTS)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3739.
sections.section_content:
The settings in the FDCAN_TTTS register select the input to be used as event trigger and
stop watch trigger.
Address offset: 0x0300
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:4 EVTSEL[1:0]: Event trigger input selection
These bits are used to select the input to be used as event trigger
00: fdcan1_evt0
01: fdcan1_evt1
10: fdcan1_evt2
11: fdcan1_evt3
Bits 3:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 1:0 SWTDEL[1:0]: Stop watch trigger input selection
These bits are used to select the input to be used as stop watch trigger
00: fdcan1_swt0
01: fdcan1_swt1
10: fdcan1_swt2
11: fdcan1_swt3
